name: Tob Run
storyline: An 18 wheeler just totaled Tob's car, but there's no time to wait around for the police! Tob has to run home NOW or she'll be late for her scheduled stream, however the crows seem to be out in numbers today and won't make the run easy!
summary:
This game was created as a 2025 birthday gift for the vtuber Toboso Kuroi.

Help Tob navigate through the murders, while using her gas-hungry flamethrower to dodge close calls. Find the Unreal Engine powerup to slow down the game for a moment, some gas canisters for her flamethrower, pipebombs to blow them crows to smithereens or find hearts to get that health back! Try to survive for as long as you can!
